# Frequently Asked Questions about Mauna Loa Volcano
### When was the most recent eruption of Mauna Loa?
Mauna Loa erupted most recently from [November-December 2022](https://www.usgs.gov/volcanoes/mauna-loa/science/november-27-december-10-2022-eruption-mauna-loa). Inouye Highway (Saddle Road). rior to that, an eruption in [March-April 1984](https://www.usgs.gov/volcanoes/mauna-loa/march-25-april-15-1984) generated fast-moving ‘a‘ā flows that advanced downslope; in a matter of days, lava was within 6 km (4 miles) of Hilo city limits. Fortunately, the 1984 eruption ended on April 15 before lava reached Hilo.

Read a more detailed narrative of Mauna Loa's [1984 Eruption: March 25-April 15](https://www.usgs.gov/volcanoes/mauna-loa/march-25-april-15-1984).

# List of volcanic eruptions in the 21st century
The largest volcanic eruption of the 21st century is the [2022 Hunga Tonga–Hunga Haʻapai eruption and tsunami](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022_Hunga_Tonga%E2%80%93Hunga_Ha%CA%BBapai_eruption_and_tsunami), and the deadliest are the [2018 Volcán de Fuego eruption](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2018_Volc%C3%A1n_de_Fuego_eruption) and the [2018 Sunda Strait tsunami](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2018_Sunda_Strait_tsunami).

## Large eruptions (VEI of 4 or higher, or plume height of at least 15 km)
| VEI | Volcano | Country | Year | Max plume height (km) | Material volume (km3) | Fatalities | Notes |
|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|
| 2-4? | [Mount Lewotobi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mount_Lewotobi)[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-GVP-Lewotobi-1) | Indonesia | 2024-ongoing | 18 |  | 13 | On 4 November 2024, the volcano spewed molten debris at several villages some 4km (2.5mi) away, destroying homes and killing at least nine.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-2) The Centre of Volcanology and Geological Hazard Mitigation recommended that a 7km (4.3mi) radius around the volcano be evacuated.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-3) Seven villages were affected by the eruption.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-4) A larger eruption occurred on 7 November.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-5) On 8 November, the volcano erupted several times, one bearing an [ash plume](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ash_plume) with a height reaching 10 km (6.2 mi).[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-6) On 9 November, it erupted again, scrambling authorities to evacuate approximately 16,000 people from nearby villages.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-7) The volcano erupted twice on 7 July 2025, the first one occurring at 11:00 local time, sending a column of volcanic materials to height up to 18 km (11 mi) which was the volcano's highest since the 7 November 2024 eruption, the second eruption occurred at 19:30 local time, spewing lava and sending clouds of ash up to 13 km (8 mi), at least 24 international flights and 4 domestic flights were cancelled as a result of the eruptions on 7 July 2025.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-8) |
| 4 | [Mount Ruang](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mount_Ruang)[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-GVP-Ruang-9) | Indonesia | 2024 | 23[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-10) |  |  | Thousands of homes were destroyed.[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-11) Volcanic ash was reported as far away as [Manado](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Manado) and several areas in [Gorontalo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gorontalo_(province)). Airlines from West Malaysia and Singapore cancelled flights to [Sabah](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sabah) and [Sarawak](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sarawak) on 18 April due to reduced visibility.[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-12)[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-13) The eruption also prompted the shutdown of [Sam Ratulangi International Airport](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sam_Ratulangi_International_Airport) in [North Sulawesi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/North_Sulawesi).[[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-14) All 843 residents of Ruang island were evacuated to Manado, while 12,000 residents of Tagulandang were relocated to [Siau Island](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Siau_Island) by ship.[[15]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-15) On 17 and 30 April, authorities raised the volcano's alert level to four, the highest in Indonesia and issued a tsunami alert which led to orders for 11,000 residents and evacuees in Tagulandang to be moved to [Manado](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Manado) in mainland [Sulawesi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sulawesi), citing the risk of the volcano collapsing into the sea.[[16]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-16) |
| 4? | [Sheveluch](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sheveluch)[[17]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-GVP-Shiveluch-17) | Russia | 2023 | 20 |  |  | An eruption on 11 April ejected a cloud of volcanic gas and ash that reached a height of 20km (12mi) and spread over an area of 108,000km2 (42,000sqmi).[[18]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-18) [Pyroclastic flows](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pyroclastic_flow) from the eruption traveled up to 19km (12mi) away from the volcano.[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-gvp11042023-19) |
| 3 | [Bezymianny](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bezymianny)[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-GVP-Bezymianny-20) | Russia | 2022 | 15 |  |  | An eruption on 28 May sent ash to an altitude of 15km, causing some disruptions to flights in the [North Pacific](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/North_Pacific), including an [American Airlines](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/American_Airlines) flight from [Dallas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dallas) to [Tokyo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tokyo) that diverted back to [Los Angeles](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Los_Angeles) midway across the Pacific, landing after approximately 12 hours in the air.[ _[citation needed](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Citation_needed)_] |
| 5-6 | [Hunga Tonga–Hunga Ha'apai](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hunga_Tonga%E2%80%93Hunga_Ha'apai)[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-GVP-Hunga_Tonga-21) | Tonga | 2022 | 58 | 6–10[[22]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-22)[[23]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-23)[[24]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-Tonga_Caldera-24) | 6 | The explosive submarine eruption began on 20 December 2021, with the [largest explosion occurring on January 15, 2022](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022_Hunga_Tonga%E2%80%93Hunga_Ha%CA%BBapai_eruption_and_tsunami). Satellite measurements recorded an eruption column of at least 30,000m (98,000ft) into the atmosphere.[[25]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-25) The explosion was hundreds of times more powerful than the [atomic bomb dropped on Hiroshima](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Little_Boy),[[26]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-26) and was heard as far as [Fairbanks](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fairbanks), [Alaska](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alaska), nearly 10,000km away. Fluctuations in air pressure were recorded all over the world as the pressure wave fully circled the world several times. Two people were killed in [Peru](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peru) by a 2-metre tsunami wave. A British woman was found to have been killed by the tsunami in Tonga.[[27]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-27) |
| 4 | [Mount Semeru](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Semeru)[[28]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-GVP-Mount_Semeru-28) | Indonesia | 2021 | 12 |  | 57 | [An eruption began on December 4](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2021_Semeru_eruption), and ejected a cloud of volcanic ash 12,000m (40,000ft) into the air, killing at least 57 people and injuring more than 100 others. |
| 4 | [Fukutoku-Okanoba](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fukutoku-Okanoba)[[29]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-GVP-Fukutoku-Okanoba-29) | Japan | 2021 | 16 |  |  | [Submarine volcano](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Submarine_volcano) approximately 1,300km south of [Tokyo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tokyo). In October, a large amount of trachytic composition pumice was seen to have been released in this eruption, and washed ashore on [Okinawa](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Okinawa_Island) and [Amami Islands](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amami_Islands).[[30]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-mainichi_2021-10-23-30)[[31]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-31)[[32]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-32) |
| 4 | [La Soufrière](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/La_Soufri%C3%A8re_(volcano))[[33]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-GVP-Soufriere-33) | Saint Vincent and the Grenadines | 2021 | 16 | 0.3 |  | [2021 eruption of La Soufrière](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2021_eruption_of_La_Soufri%C3%A8re) |

At approximately 4 am, 22 June it erupted, with a plume of ash and gas reaching between 13,000m (43,000ft) and 17,000m (56,000ft), passing the [tropopause](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tropopause) and allowing [stratospheric](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stratospheric) injection of [ash](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Volcanic_ash) and [sulfur dioxide](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sulfur_dioxide).[[40]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-40) |

At least one commercial aircraft flew into the plume, later landing safely but incurring costly engine damage.[[52]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-52) |
| 4 | [Mount Sinabung](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mount_Sinabung)[[53]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-GVP-Sinabung-53) | Indonesia | 2013-2019 | 16.8 |  | 23 | [Mount Sinabung](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mount_Sinabung)'s eruptions caused many pyroclastic flows, one resulting in the loss of 16 lives.[[54]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-:1-54) An eruption on 22 May 2016, resulted in the loss of 7 lives.[[55]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-55) |

| 4 | [Eyjafjallajökull](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eyjafjallaj%C3%B6kull)[[64]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-GVP-Eyjafjallaj%C3%B6kull-64) | Iceland | 2010 | 9 | 0.25[[65]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-65) |  | [A series of eruptions between March and June](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2010_eruptions_of_Eyjafjallaj%C3%B6kull) caused the worst flight disruption over Europe since the Second World War.[[66]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-66) Over an eight-day period, an estimated 107,000 flights, representing 48% of total air traffic and 10 million passengers, were canceled.[[67]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-67) According to the [IATA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_Air_Transport_Association), The total loss to the airline industry was around $1.7 billion.[[68]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_in_the_21st_century#cite_note-68) |

The brief, but unforgettable eruption of Mauna Loa.
![Map of the current eruption of Mauna Loa.](https://www.nps.gov/havo/learn/nature/images/MicrosoftTeams-image-104.png?maxwidth=650&autorotate=false)The 2022 eruption of Mauna Loa produced lava flows that predominately traveled north towards Daniel K. Inouye State Highway 200 before ending.
USGS Map
## Mauna Loa Erupts
The largest active volcano in the world, Mauna Loa, erupted for about 12 days in late 2022, the first eruption since 1984.
The eruption began in Mokuʻāweoweo, the summit caldera of Mauna Loa, around 11:30 p.m. HST on Sunday November 27, 2022. After several hours, new fissures opened some distance away from the summit along the Northeast Rift Zone. Soonafter, the summit fissures stopped erupting. By Friday, December 2, the eruption was limited to fissure 3 along the Northwest Rift Zone. Fissure 3, the only active fissure, was producing between 50 and 100 cubic yards of lava per second, flowing down slope and out of the park to the north towards Daniel K. Inoye State Highway 200 (Saddle Road).
**On December 13, 2022 the Hawaiian Volcano Observatory determined that "Mauna Loa is no longer erupting.**" Adding, "Lava supply to the fissure 3 vent on the Northeast Rift Zone ceased on December 10 and sulfur dioxide emissions have decreased to near pre-eruption background levels."

# Mauna Loa Awakens
after 38 years of sustained quiet...
Chronology of the 2022 Mauna Loa Eruption
November 30, 2022
01 / 06
1
### Mauna Loa Volcano Erupts in Moku‘āweoweo Caldera
On November 27, 2022, at approximately 11:30 p.m. a fissure opened on the floor of the summit caldera of Mauna Loa. Within hours, lava filled Mokuʻāweoweo crater forming a lava lake.
Video showing thermal imagery of the initial phase of the Mauna Loa eruption.
2
### Brief Overflows to the South
Within a few hours of the eruption, the fissure that first opened in Mokuʻāweoʻweo continued opening towards the south. This produced a lava flow that was visible from the Kona coast. These flows did not threaten any populated areas and was short-lived. Lava flows in the summit region, cascaded in a pit south of the main caldera.
3
### Eruption Moves from Summit to Northeast Flank
By 6:30 a.m. on November 28, the eruption had migrated to the upper Northeast Rift Zone. Fountains of lava with heights between 100 to 200 feet (30-60 meters) erupted from three fissures in an area called a rift zone. This is a weak area formed due to spreading of the volcano as it settles and provides the path of least resistance for magma to travel from underground to the surface. Geologist estimated that 130 cubic yards (100 cubic meters) of lava per second erupted from the vent at this stage.
Video showing the start of the Northeast Rift Zone eruption. A single car drives on a highway with views of an eruption in a distance.
4
### Fissure 3 and 4 Produce Vigorous Lava Flows
As the magma migrated to the Northeast Rift Zone of Mauna Loa, the eruption's initial phase at the summit ceased. On November 29, 2022 two active fissures continued to feed lava flows downslope. Fissure 3 produced the most significant lava flows that traveled northeast, moving towards Daniel K. Inouye State Highway 200 (Saddle Road). “The flows advanced at a rate of 0.08 miles per hour (130 meters per hour),” according to a USGS Hawaiian Volcano Observatory geologist. Fissure 4 produced flows that moved east at a slower rate and became inactive over the next couple days.
Aerial footage of lava fountains 65 to 80 feet (20 to 25 meters) in height. Lava flows downslope towards the slopes of Mauna Kea volcano.
5
### Lava Flows Approach Daniel K. Inouye State Highway 200
By the morning of December 7, the leading edge of the lava flow on the northeast flank of Mauna Loa was under the 7,000-foot elevation and around 1.8 miles (2.9 kilometers) from Daniel K. Inouye State Highway 200.  The lava has slowed to less than 20 feet (6 meters) of forward progress per hour. The flow is moving over flat terrain and is expected to spread out and slow down even more.
Video of ʻaʻā flow on northeast flank of Mauna Loa.

6
### The Eruption Comes to an End
On the night of December 7, lava fountain heights grew overnight sending lava between 200 to 500 feet (60 - 150 meters) above fissure 3.
The next day on December 8, lava was overtopping channels near the vent. The lava flows appeared to drain of lava and no longer feed the main flow, which stalled about 1.7 mi (2.8 km) from the Daniel K. Inouye Highway (Saddle Road).
**On December 13, 2022, USGS Hawaiian Volcano Observatory determined that Mauna Loa was no longer erupting.** Adding, "Lava supply to the fissure 3 vent on the Northeast Rift Zone ceased on December 10 and sulfur dioxide emissions have decreased to near pre-eruption background levels."
